title: Highly efficient Zn1−xCdxS catalysts with sphalerite structures synthesized via a novel green method for hydrogen production by water splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37763-37773
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05402D, Paper
Open Access

M. González-Rodríguez, S. Díaz-Coello, S. Díaz-González, V. D. Rodríguez, M. Žitňan, G. Galleani, J. J. Velázquez, E. Pastor, P. Núñez
Zn1−xCdxS was prepared by a new green and simple method. The best catalyst Zn0.7Cd0.3S produced 29.5 mmol h−1 gcat−1 of hydrogen under visible light and 795.4 mmol h−1 gcat−1 under UV light.
